title: Lip-sync video exports work again
summary: Lip-sync video exports work again, lip-synced voices are heard in audio-only exports, and a welcome video greets new members on the dashboard.

items.title: A short welcome video on your first visit.
items.body: The organization dashboard shows a "Welcome to Vitra.ai Universe" video once per person, with **Skip to get started**. Watch it again any time with the **Watch welcome video** command in Cmd+K.

items.title: Video exports with lip-sync on failed before they started.
items.body: They now run, and a lip-sync clip that was already paid for is still never charged twice.

items.title: Lip-synced cards were silent in audio-only exports.
items.body: Audio-only exports now play each card's dub, and no longer need a lip-sync key.

items.title: Video exports with lip-sync off could fail
items.body: on projects that had lip-synced cards. Those cards now play their own dub.
